prompt_meta.title: Auth + Session Foundation (GA-grade) with FULL executor responsibility (incl. Docker/infra startup)

step_objectives.goal: Build GA-grade authentication and session foundation across API/Web/Mobile with consent tracking and account deletion flows. Executor is responsible for all system actions required (Docker/infra/tools).
outcomes: Executor ensures Docker + infra actually runs (or reports exact automation blocker)
Secure account creation and login supported end-to-end
Session model is production-ready (revocation, refresh strategy, expiry, multi-device support)
User profile stores locale + basic identity fields
Consent records stored (privacy/terms; location consent placeholder supported)
constraints: IDE chooses auth approach and must document tradeoffs.
No social login in this step; only foundation for it later.
definition_of_done: Docker daemon is started by IDE and infra is up OR step is BLOCKED with an un-automatable OS/permission reason captured in report
API auth endpoints exist and pass automated tests
Web can login and reach a protected page; tests pass
Mobile can login and reach a protected screen; tests pass

deliverables_outcomes.goal: IDE must attempt to automatically make the environment runnable.
requirements: Detect OS and attempt to start Docker daemon automatically.

If Docker is not installed, attempt installation if feasible from command-line/package manager; if installation requires interactive UI/admin approval that cannot be automated, capture it precisely and mark BLOCKED.
After Docker is running, bring up infra via docker compose.
acceptance_criteria: Report contains: OS detected, Docker start/install attempts, command outputs, and final status
If BLOCKED: includes exact blocker (e.g., admin prompt) and what prevented automation

requirements: Account creation and login (IDE chooses method).
Session lifecycle: issue, refresh/renew, logout, revoke (multi-device safe).
Protected endpoint (/me or equivalent) returning user profile with locale.
Brute-force mitigation for auth endpoints (IDE chooses; document).
acceptance_criteria: Protected endpoints cannot be accessed without valid auth

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Versioned consent tracking (ready for KR compliance work later).
requirements: Record acceptance of Terms + Privacy Policy during onboarding (timestamped, versioned).
Placeholder support for location consent tracking (even if device permission not requested yet).
acceptance_criteria: Consent is enforced before full access
Consent records are retrievable for authenticated user

requirements: User can request deletion from web + mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover deletion request and post-request behavior

deliverables_outcomes.goal: KO/EN auth screens wired to API with persistence.
requirements: Localized login flow in web + mobile
Protected screen/page shows user identity (localized labels)
Auth persistence across refresh/restart (method chosen by IDE)
acceptance_criteria: Web automated test: protected route requires auth
Mobile automated test: auth persistence logic works headlessly

requirements: ops/AUTH_MODEL.md: flow, session strategy, expiry, revocation, multi-device, storage approach
ops/SECURITY_NOTES.md: threat considerations, rate limiting, secrets handling (dev vs prod), future social login plan
acceptance_criteria: Docs complete and match implementation choices

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate anything to the owner. Attempt to start/install Docker and bring infra up. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0003.report.json with no placeholders.
